core: TGF-beta and BMP SMAD signaling regulation
name: TGF-beta and BMP SMAD signaling with miRNA regulation
rationale: All members concern positive or negative regulation of TGF-beta/BMP receptor-SMAD signaling and SMAD-linked miRNA transcription and processing; the BMP and miRNA members distinguish it from the TGFBR3/activin, fibrosis, extracellular-sequestration and cancer-mutant confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and adrenal corticosteroid synthesis
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, aldosterone synthesis/secretion/response and renal sodium and blood-volume control; the mineralocorticoid/glucocorticoid biosynthesis members separate it from the vasopressin, water and natriuretic confusables.

name: Synaptic vesicle docking and priming for neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members are the transmitter-specific release cycles plus vesicle docking, SNARE assembly and priming, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on calcium-triggered fusion and exocytosis regulation.

core: Nucleotide sugar synthesis and Golgi transport
qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid, with inherited defects
name: UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid nucleotide sugar synthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid metabolism plus SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporters and their disease defects, distinguishing it from glycan-assembly, GPI, fucose and UDP-glucose confusables.

name: Coagulation, platelet activation and eicosanoid lipid mediator signaling
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade and its inherited defects, vitamin K-dependent carboxylation, platelet receptor activation and fibrinolysis together with eicosanoid, specialized pro-resolving mediator and lipid-receptor signaling; the eicosanoid/lipid-mediator block separates it from the integrin-adhesion confusable sharing the platelet core, and hemostasis separates it from complement, lipoprotein and glycerolipid confusables.

name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism via beta-oxidation and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies, PDH/OGDH/BCKDH/OADH complexes with their lipoyl, biotin and CoA cofactors, and branched-chain amino acid catabolism defects; this separates it from B-vitamin cofactor and carnitine-synthesis/peroxisomal confusables.

name: Immediate-early stress response to UV, TNF and mitogens
rationale: Members are acute transcriptional and kinase responses to external stimuli (TNF/NF-kB, UV-B, phorbol ester, nitric oxide, growth factors via PI3K and p38, growth arrest); the UV and phorbol/nitric-oxide responses separate it from AP-1/JNK-centred and senescence confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of metabolism under stress
name: HIF, NRF2 and p53 regulation of glycolytic and redox metabolism
rationale: Members are hypoxia/HIF, NFE2L2/BACH1 and p53/mTORC1 programs that tune glycolysis, pentose phosphate and nucleotide metabolism; HIF and NRF2 together separate it from glycolysis-enzyme, ROS/ferroptosis and FOXO/AKT confusables.

name: FGFR3 ligand binding and downstream signaling
rationale: All members concern FGFR3 isoform ligand activation, its FRS/SHC cascades or activating mutants, distinguishing it from confusables built on FGFR1, FGFR2 and FGFR4.

name: Germ cell development and sperm midpiece motility
rationale: Members span primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation/death and meiotic entry, the Sertoli barrier, and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly and motility; the motility/midpiece members separate it from gonad and oocyte confusables, and germline development from axoneme-assembly and fertilization confusables.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate turnover by hexokinases, glucose-6-phosphatase and glycogenolysis
rationale: Members concern formation and disposal of glucose-6-phosphate via hexokinase/glucokinase, G6PC/SLC37A4 (with their deficiency diseases), glycogen breakdown and early glycolysis, distinguishing it from glycogen synthesis, gluconeogenesis and fructose/glycerol confusables.

qualifier: sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib, lestaurtinib and related inhibitors
name: FLT3 mutant resistance to sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib and lestaurtinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific tyrosine kinase inhibitors; the inhibitor set (sorafenib, crenolanib, tandutinib, tamatinib, ponatinib, lestaurtinib) is what separates it from the gilteritinib/midostaurin/quizartinib FLT3 confusable, KIT-resistance and FLT3 signaling confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct formation and bud elongation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and elongation
rationale: All members concern formation, elongation and branching of the nephric duct/ureteric bud epithelial tube and ureter, distinguishing it from confusables on intermediate mesoderm induction, metanephric mesenchyme and kidney size control.

qualifier: global-genome NER and polymerase eta bypass
name: UV lesion repair via global-genome NER and polymerase eta bypass
rationale: Members cover UV/pyrimidine-dimer response, global-genome NER recognition and incision, and error-free POLH translesion synthesis, distinguishing it from transcription-coupled NER, error-prone TLS and gap-filling/replication confusables.

qualifier: type I interferon and NF-kB induction
name: RIG-I-like receptor induction of type I interferon and NF-kB
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling with TRAF6- and FADD/RIP1-mediated NF-kB activation and positive regulation of interferon-alpha/beta production, contrasting with confusables centred on IRF activation, negative regulators, dsRNA sensing and viral evasion.

name: Cytochrome P450 oxidation of fatty acids and eicosanoids
rationale: The three members are the cytochrome P450 substrate-class groupings (fatty acids, eicosanoids, miscellaneous substrates), distinguishing it from confusables built on specific cyclooxygenase, lipoxygenase, epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase and leukotriene/lipoxin branches.

name: Coronavirus genome replication and APOBEC3G cytidine deaminase restriction
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting, capping and host translation modulation with host restriction by APOBEC3G C-to-U editing/deamination and foreign nucleic acid clearance; the APOBEC3G arm separates it from viral-translation confusables and the coronavirus arm from the ADAR A-to-I editing confusable.

name: Endothelial shear stress mechanotransduction and eNOS trafficking
rationale: Members are laminar and oscillatory shear responses via PIEZO1/PECAM1/KDR plus NOSIP/NOSTRIN eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2 permeability; the eNOS and VEGFR2 members separate it from SRF, integrin/Rap1, osteocyte mechanical load and smooth muscle confusables.

qualifier: canalicular phospholipid and bile acid export
name: Phospholipid translocation and canalicular bile acid secretion
rationale: Members concern flipping/flopping of aminophospholipids and sphingolipids and the ABCB4/ABCB11 canalicular transporters for phosphatidylcholine and bile salts, distinguishing it from lipoprotein/sterol-efflux, xenobiotic export and membrane-traffic confusables.

name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover mannose trimming to hybrid/complex N-glycans, antennae elongation, sialylation and poly-LacNAc, and GalNAc-initiated O-glycan synthesis with its GALNT/C1GALT1C1 defects; these separate it from ER N-glycan processing and fucose/blood-group antigen confusables.

qualifier: fork reversal, R-loops and DNA-protein crosslinks
name: Replication fork stress, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink resolution
rationale: Members are responses to replication-blocking agents (camptothecin, hydroxyurea), fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA topology changes and protein-DNA crosslink repair, distinguishing it from telomere maintenance, homologous recombination and replication-initiation confusables.

name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate cell death triggered by hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides, including intrinsic apoptosis and iron-dependent ferroptosis; the ferroptosis/iron members and peroxide focus distinguish it from nitrosative/ischemia, respiration-control and general oxidative-stress confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase activation of PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: ALK/LTK receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are LTK and MDK/PTN-ALK signaling, tyrosine autophosphorylation and their downstream PI3K/AKT and ERK1/2 activation (including aberrant PI3K), distinguishing it from erythropoietin, oncogenic RTK fusion, PTK6 and MET confusables.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and nucleotide phosphorylation
name: Nucleoside transport and nucleotide phosphorylation with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (incl. SLC29A3 and abacavir/ribavirin uptake), mitochondrial ADP/ATP carriers and nucleoside mono/diphosphate phosphorylation; the kinase and mitochondrial-carrier members separate it from thiopurine/NUDT drug-metabolism confusables, and nucleoside transport from creatine/nucleotide-synthesis confusables.

name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface-gene signatures of resting/activated dendritic cells, plasma cells and Th1 CD4 T cells plus butyrophilin interactions and exosome assembly; the dendritic and plasma/T cell signatures separate it from monocyte, B cell and T cell-costimulation confusables.
